text: in cart/editor there is a real problem with state between when a mode is actually active versus what is displayed in the mesh editor. heres a demonstration, you can see here that i have [Image #1] none of the tools active, and yet [Image #2][Image #3] i can face select [Image #4] all while they show as inactive
resolution: Fixed mesh editor mode/state drift: ModelView now adopts the host's authoritative selection mode from __mesh_edit_counts whenever native selection changes, and AppFrame pings that callback after shell-driven part face selection so toolbar highlights track the active face/edge/vertex mode. Verified with SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship editor.
